text: {"sql":"SELECT c.level AS level, SUM(oi.amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS avg_order_value FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY c.level ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC","unanswerable":false,"unanswerableReason":""}
